title: nife: Oral biofilm community dynamics — Hamilton/gLV inference with metabolic sign priors
description: Computational pipeline for oral biofilm community dynamics (NIFE / SIIRI TRR-298). Connects patient metagenomics to COMETS/dFBA simulation and Hamilton/gLV ecological inference with metabolic sign priors. Light reproduction via scripts/reproduce_core.sh with CI-tested ETL unit tests.
